audience: franchise field-service teams that book jobs, send proposals and bill customers in ServiceMinder

useCases.title: Find a customer and their open proposals
useCases.text: Search contacts by name, phone, email or tag. Then list that contact's proposals and open one to read its lines and totals.

useCases.title: List unpaid invoices from last month
useCases.text: List invoices by date range and open one to see its payments. Use the payment list to check which invoices are still unpaid.

useCases.title: Plan tomorrow's appointments by agent
useCases.text: List the appointments for a date range, filtered by service agent. Use the agent list to match each visit to a field worker.

useCases.title: Add a lead and a follow-up task
useCases.text: Add the lead with a name and a phone or email. Then add a note and a callback task for the contact. Nothing is deleted.
